title: CLEAR-EC Phase 2 experiment log (parent session), 2026-10-26 to 2026-10-30
note: one entry per experiment; numbers are five-fold OOF or fold4-matched MAPE unless stated; files are repo-relative under results/ (pod copies under experiments/)

entries.question: does std pooling beat mean on another seed and fold?
entries.result: 4/4 paired wins, pooled -0.080 pp (CI -0.116..-0.048)
entries.verdict: recipe A = std pooling (user-confirmed 10-27)

entries.question: auxiliary point loss during regression
entries.result: lambda .01 +0.027, lambda .1 +0.047 (worse); lambda .3 withdrawn pre-GPU (gradient ratio 179x)
entries.verdict: negative

entries.question: which encoder carries most cell-position information?
entries.result: val-5 point F1: lattice .378, SSL5 .469, recipe A .556, aux encoder .639
entries.verdict: regression fine-tuning increases point information

entries.question: T4 feasibility
entries.result: fp16 0.99 GiB peak with memory-efficient SDPA; math-only SDPA OOM (18.5 GiB); fp16 vs fp32 drift 0.07%
entries.verdict: deployable if SDPA kernel asserted

entries.question: five-fold OOF of recipe A seed 46 (fresh SSL for folds 1-3; fold2 via official zero rule)
entries.result: 9.046 single; fold2 first root failed its own CPU gate (float equality), rerun as _v2
entries.verdict: baseline fixed

entries.question: TTA and scalar-calibration gates
entries.result: TTA -0.025 (5/5 folds) adopt; LOFO scalars -0.036 adopt; pipeline 8.985
entries.verdict: both adopted

entries.question: detector/specialist point-map features stacked on the OOF
entries.result: worse on every fold (+0.04..+0.16); later shown to be mostly the ridge intercept
entries.verdict: negative

entries.question: hybrid of recipe A with the Phase-1 crop members
entries.verdict: submission-1 frontrunner

entries.question: regression-seed sensitivity
entries.result: per-fold spread 0.01-0.05; TTA -0.007..-0.037 on every model
entries.verdict: seed-only ensemble ties Phase-1 six (+0.004 on fold4)

entries.question: weak supervision / LLM-in-the-loop on 25 annotated images
entries.result: only hex6 HEX feature survives: A -0.047, B -0.029 (13 detectors); CD/CV nothing
entries.verdict: hex6 -> submission 2 (PI 10-30)

entries.question: pre-registered rule: candidate vs Phase-1 six on matched 1778 rows
entries.result: hybrid 3-seed+six 8.798 vs 8.888 (-0.090, CI excludes 0); recipe A alone 8.892
entries.verdict: submission 1 = hybrid (proposed, PI confirmation pending)

entries.question: submission members: all-data SSL5 + 3 regression seeds on 8952 rows
entries.result: 3 members trained and audited; placeholder scores on the 2 held zero rows are not an evaluation
entries.verdict: ready for packaging

entries.question: per-target specialists as diverse members
entries.result: CD specialist -0.09..-0.11 CD (fold0/4); CV +0.08, HEX +0.22 (worse)
entries.verdict: only CD specialist is a candidate column member; evaluate on hybrid LOFO

entries.question: integrated hybrid inference on real MHA under T4 constraints
entries.result: n=60 fold4 images: recipe A path reproduces stored TTA to 0.15%; full-data members agree within 0.5-0.8% log spread; memory-efficient SDPA asserted; peak 2.64 GiB under a 15 GiB cap; 12.9 s/image on H200 (Phase-1 40 views x 6 members ~11 s of it). Phase-1 app vs stored fold-clean OOF: median 1.1%, p90 ~3%, one image 17% (1770-18, CD 1057: fold-clean OOF 1332 vs release 1104 vs target 1057) — all explained by the release members being all-data refits (fold4 in their training set).
entries.verdict: integration PASS; container image clear-ec-hybrid:20261030 built on the build box (PyTorch 2.11 + CUDA 12.6, click<8.4 pin for pip check); T4-image run with mounted models pending

entries.question: CD specialist as the CD column of the recipe-A half of hybrid B
entries.result: fold0: replace +0.007 CD / avg -0.003; fold4: replace +0.010 / avg -0.001; mean within 0.001
entries.verdict: negative; specialist track closed (CV/HEX specialists already worse alone)

entries.question: does the built image produce the same prediction as the pod integration test under Grand-Challenge-like conditions?
entries.result: clear-ec-hybrid:20261030 on the build box (RTX 4090, --network none, --memory 16g, models mounted read-only): 0234-20 -> CD 2977.94 / CV 0.4163 / HEX 0.4808, identical to the pod test to 4 decimals; 22 s wall, 28 MB host RSS; CPDINO backbone path mapped by symlink onto the model mount so frozen sources are untouched
entries.verdict: PASS; packaging (docker save + model tar + SHA256) started

entries.question: does changing the SSL seed (1003->1004) change recipe A on fold4?
entries.result: single view 9.0255 vs 9.0479 (SSL seed 1003); with four-flip TTA 8.9897 (-0.0355 from its single view) = best fold4 single-member score so far (seed-46/1003 TTA was 9.0072)
entries.verdict: SSL-seed diversity is the strongest member-level lever found; fold0 replication (SSL 1004 + regression + TTA) and fold4 SSL 1005 queued on GPUs 0,1; evaluate as hybrid members by LOFO when two folds exist

entries.question: can detector quality be lifted beyond the 20 annotated images (GT-scored selection, soft-hex6 weak loss, external Topcon pre-training)?
entries.result: G1a GT-correlation selection: r 0.38-0.56 uncorrelated with held-out F1 (400-row SE ~0.045; 2000-row re-test queued); as 14th member B -0.0282. Subset selection B -0.0272. G1b soft-hex6 surrogate failed its 20-image test (r -0.15/0.28) -> parked. External pre-training round 1 (2000 updates, 1.30x): val-5 F1 .642 unchanged, coverage unchanged (ROI-sized cluster), B -0.0286; round 2 (transfer check, 6000 updates, 1.11x) queued. G3 delivered: 9 fold-99 detectors, full-fit a=-0.223 b=0.584 w=0.26, Hex6Corrector 0.68 s/image, tests pass, LOFO estimate -0.0274 on B.
entries.verdict: hex6 on the hybrid is pinned at -0.027..-0.029 regardless of detector work; submission-2 fallback package exists

entries.question: does a detector trained ONLY on the external Topcon points (never fine-tuned on the 20 CLEAR-EC images) add independent HEX information?
entries.result: nine frozen detectors + one pre-only detector: base B -0.0934 pp HEX = -0.0311 pp mean, HEX improving 5/5 folds, 3/5 folds <= -0.03 (per fold -0.047/-0.031/-0.042/-0.027/-0.009); base A -0.0515 mean. Pre-only detector is the strongest single member (-0.064 HEX on A) despite the lowest val-5 F1 (0.54-0.59): its errors are independent of the 20-image fine-tune shared by all other detectors.
entries.verdict: FIRST pass of the PI gate on the submission base (>= 0.03, HEX >= 4 folds). Caveats: marginal (-0.031), one of five pre-registered round-2 variants. Confirmation with two more pre-only seeds + 12-detector blend queued; decision rule fixed: <= -0.035 & >= 3 folds -> nine + three pre-only in submission 2; -0.030..-0.035 -> nine + one; else nine frozen.

entries.question: does a per-image fault guard change any output on normal images, and does it keep every faulty case alive?
entries.result: byte-identical outputs to the verified 2026-10-30 image on 4/4 normal cases (three platform debug MHAs + 0234-20); 8/8 fault cases exit 0 with valid outputs (RGB, uint16, all-zero -> hybrid; 960x1280 crop -> phase1_only; unreadable -> constant; injected faults -> expected fallback); Phase-1 half matches the platform T4 outputs to 1.5e-6 relative
entries.verdict: ADOPTED for submission 1; image sha 31c5f3be..., model archive unchanged (9.21 GB, sha 1134b453...)

entries.question: how much headroom is there below our error?
entries.result: HEX floor 8.6 (ROI half-split, technician markers) vs hybrid 10.12, shared-error bound 10.04; CD floor 3.9-4.7 vs 6.31; CV proxy invalid; recombining the two existing predictors capped at ~0.1 pp (95-98 % of error variance shared); 0/6768 donors span two folds
entries.verdict: stay on plan; no new exploration track before the deadline; ROI-aware pooling = post-challenge research; fold donor-independence confirmed

entries.question: where does the hybrid gain come from (slices)?
entries.verdict: B is never worse than P1 in any year group -> submission 1 unchanged; submission-2 increments must also be checked on the black-frame stratum

entries.question: does a style-gated hybrid weight (black frame > 1 %) beat the fixed 0.5?
entries.result: LOFO w: full-frame 0.70-0.75, black-frame 0.35-0.40; dev folds 0-3 -0.014 [-0.026,-0.003], fold 4 -0.014, 5/5 folds improving; 2023-2024 -0.001
entries.verdict: NOT ADOPTED (pre-set bar -0.02 not met); the recent-year weakness of recipe A is not fixable by reweighting

entries.question: does a member on a second SSL encoder (seed 1004) improve the hybrid enough for submission 2?
entries.result: four members (s46/47/48 on SSL1003 + s46 on SSL1004) vs three: fold 0 +0.005 [+0.001,+0.009], fold 4 -0.005 [-0.010,+0.000]; swap s48 for SSL1004: fold 0 +0.009, fold 4 -0.005; single members within the s46/47/48 spread
entries.verdict: GATE FAILED (needed <= -0.03 on both folds); no full-data SSL1004 training; submission 2 = hybrid B + hex6 (nine + pre-only s46)

entries.question: nine + three pre-only vs nine + one vs nine (fixed rule)
entries.result: 12 detectors on B: -0.0326 mean, HEX 5/5 folds, 4/5 folds <= -0.03; single pre-only s46 as 10th: -0.0311
entries.verdict: middle band -> nine + pre-only s46 deployed (a -0.2084, b 0.5989, w 0.28); v2 unit + container regression tests passed (green session report, deploy files verified on the pod)

entries.question: is recipe A's weakness proportional to the black-frame size (normalisation hypothesis)?
entries.result: A - P1: no frame -0.209, frame 1-5 % +0.174, 5-10 % +0.108, 10-20 % +0.041, >20 % +0.095 (a step, not a dose); within 2019-2022 no frame -0.229 vs frame +0.061; the 1/99 percentile window changes only 4 % on framed images
entries.verdict: normalisation hypothesis rejected; std pooling over black tokens remains; inference-only masked-pooling probe started on GPU 0 (folds 4 and 0)

entries.question: does the deployed hex6 blend hold on the black-frame stratum, recent years, and the shipped three-seed + six base?
entries.result: all -0.031 [-0.044,-0.019]; black_frac > 0.01 -0.021 [-0.041,-0.001]; no frame -0.040; 2023-2024 -0.032 [-0.066,-0.000]; fold 4 on the shipped hybrid -0.0139 vs -0.0143 on B under the same parameters (weakest fold; CI crosses zero)
entries.verdict: parameters transfer to the shipped composition; keep nine + pre-only s46 for submission 2; carry the five-fold -0.031

entries.question: does excluding black tokens at inference help a model trained with unmasked std pooling?
entries.result: framed images: fold 4 9.43 -> 12.56, fold 0 9.57 -> 11.56; unframed unchanged (8.69 -> 8.72, 8.68 -> 8.67)
entries.verdict: inconclusive by design (train/test pooling mismatch); retrained masked-pooling arms started (fold 4 on GPUs 0-1, fold 0 prepared), protocol pre-registered

entries.question: can head-only detectors on the frozen recipe A encoder (zero extra ViT passes on T4) replace the ten fine-tuned detectors?
entries.result: frozen set on B -0.0112 mean (HEX 5/5 folds, 0/5 folds <= -0.03) vs active ten -0.0311; mixing frozen into the ten dilutes it (-0.0267); val-5 F1 0.57-0.62 vs 0.62-0.69; correction 2026-10-31 (green session): the -0.0112 included one fine-tuned stride-8 member by default; frozen heads only = -0.0075
entries.verdict: keep the active ten for submission 2 (projected T4 exec ~130-150 s < 300 s limit); frozen family is the documented fallback after an A10G switch

entries.question: does retraining recipe A with black-frame-masked std pooling recover its advantage on framed images?
entries.verdict: REJECTED (continue rule needed framed <= -0.15); cause of the framed-image weakness stays open (device/magnification/eye bank suspected); fold 0 finishes for description only

entries.question: can the T4 container (fp16, memory-efficient SDPA; no flash, no bf16 on sm75) reproduce the green hex6 values?
entries.result: 25-image fixture: original path exact; wrapper bf16 with efficient SDPA max HEX 1.0 % / feature 0.059; wrapper fp16 0.79 % / 0.047; 239-242 of 250 per-detector hex6 values move (peak-level jitter); fp16 3.1 s/image for ten detectors on H200; peak 10.4 GiB with three correctors loaded
entries.verdict: bit-reproduction impossible on T4 by construction; impact on the score is being measured directly (green session: fp16 + efficient-SDPA OOF recompute of all ten families, LOFO and deployed-parameter blends)

entries.question: does the submission-2 path (guarded hybrid fp16 + hex6 T4 wrapper) run correctly on real MHAs?
entries.result: 60 fold-4 MHAs: guarded hybrid identical to the submission-1 n60 hybrid (max rel 0.0); CD/CV unchanged 60/60; hex6 applied 60/60, no fallback; HEX change median 1.2 %, max 5.9 %; 22 s hybrid + 3.2 s hex6 per image on a shared H200; corrector load 15 s; peak 5.8 GiB; sample HEX MAPE 10.20 -> 10.59 on in-sample images (not an estimate)
entries.verdict: path correct; calibration check below

entries.question: do the deployed fold-99 detectors (fp16) produce the same feature scale the blend parameters were fitted on (fold-clean OOF, bf16)?
entries.result: same 60 images: mean difference 0.0018 (SE 0.0043), sd 0.033, corr 0.967; corr with log GT HEX 0.497 (deployed) vs 0.477 (OOF); implied systematic HEX shift 0.03 %. Note: the OOF feature npz is in cache-row order (align via hybrid_oof indices), not hybrid_oof row order
entries.verdict: no calibration shift; a/b/w transfer to the deployed detectors; the 60-image HEX worsening is sampling noise on in-sample images

entries.id: green_track t4_numerics (pre-set rule: seven-family fp16 within 0.005 of bf16 AND deployed a/b/w on fp16 <= -0.025)
entries.question: does the hex6 benefit survive the T4 numerics (fp16, memory-efficient SDPA)?
entries.result: seven families, same fold-clean checkpoints: LOFO bf16 -0.0291 vs fp16 -0.0281 (diff 0.0010); deployed a/b/w on fp16 features (three stride-8 families bf16, no fold-clean checkpoints): -0.0326, 5/5 folds; family-mean feature corr bf16 vs fp16 0.980 (seven) / 0.989 (ten mixed)
entries.verdict: PASS: shipped hex6 unchanged for submission 2; T4 handled by the container wrapper (hex6_t4_20261101.py), green deploy/ untouched

entries.question: does the submission-2 image keep CD/CV identical to submission 1, apply hex6, and survive faults?
entries.result: 4/4 normal cases: CD/CV byte-identical to submission 1, HEX before correction identical, hex6 applied, HEX change -0.8..+3.0 %; injected hex6 fault -> output byte-identical to submission 1; RGB/uint16 -> hybrid + hex6; 960x1280 crop -> phase1_only, hex6 error caught; all-zero -> hex6 fallback; unreadable -> constants; 35-42 s per case wall on the 4090 (submission 1: 22 s); image 11.3 GB uncompressed
entries.verdict: ALL CHECKS PASSED; packaging (docker save | gzip) running in package_20261101/; T4 time to be measured by Try-out
